newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3859/3.3890 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3859/3.3890 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Cairo banks quoted the dollar at 3.3830 to 3.3880 pounds bid and 3.3840 to 3.3930 pounds offered in the interbank market on Wednesday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3859 pounds bid and 3.3890 pounds offered. The averages compared with 3.3852 and 3.3901 pounds on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at the opening at 3.390793 buy and 3.394545 sell.
